last_sync.summary: Audited 2 commits: a README rewrite introducing the Capoworks ECU overview and its merge. The README is a repository landing page, not a docs/ page; the user-facing wiki already covers the highlighted features (blended fuel, air-mass migration, VE Analyze, Core8 tools, tune format 20032). No docs/ file requires a change.

decisions.rationale: This commit only rewrites the repository root README.md, which is not part of the docs/ wiki tree. Every user-facing claim it introduces (blended Speed Density/Alpha-N authority, 16x16 per-cylinder trims, independent load sources, rolling idle feedback, Legacy/Cycle Profile/Time Budget ignition selectors, tune format 20032 reset behavior, VE Analyze authority restriction, Core8 build tools) is already documented in the existing wiki pages, and the README links to those pages rather than adding new behavior. No docs/ page content becomes inaccurate.
evidence: README.md: "Current tune format: 20032. Binary tunes from older formats are reset rather than automatically migrated." — already covered in docs/08-Fuel/Fuel-Algorithms/Airmass-Models-and-Migration.md
README.md links to existing pages: Fuel/Fuel-Algorithms/Blended/, Airmass-Models-and-Migration/, Fuel-Settings/VE-Analyze/, Software/Core8-Build-Tools/
README.md Credits section attributes derivation to FOME-Tech/fome-fw and rusEFI/rusefi with independence disclaimer — consistent with existing docs attribution

decisions.rationale: Merge commit integrating the README branch. The merge diff shows no conflict-resolution content beyond the child commit's README change, so it adds no distinct user-facing documentation impact.
